name: Pravin Muley
player_statement:
A complete player, Pravin Muley has made a big mark in cricket. With 10 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 28*, with an average of 10.83 and a quick strike rate of 135.42. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 6 sixes and 1 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 9.0 overs, taking 3 wickets at an economy rate of 10.56. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
